_about: The mtime each file in this fixture is stamped with, in epoch seconds. Git carries no mtimes, so a fresh checkout would sort this Library by whenever it was cloned; these are what make the Date sort the same on every machine. legacy/tools/shoot.mjs --library seeds them into the Parity oracle's browser Library, and the app's --library stamps them onto its copy of the tree. The dot-folder is stamped like the rest: it is hidden from the Library, not missing from the disk.
